title.en: See the upgrade handshake in the capture

why.en: The first packets are plain HTTP with Upgrade headers and a 101 reply.
why.hinglish: Pehle packets Upgrade headers wale plain HTTP aur 101 reply hain.

expect.en: A GET with Upgrade: websocket and Sec-WebSocket-Key, then 101 Switching Protocols with Sec-WebSocket-Accept. Values differ in your copy.
expect.hinglish: Upgrade: websocket aur Sec-WebSocket-Key wala GET, phir Sec-WebSocket-Accept ke saath 101 Switching Protocols. Tumhari copy mein values alag ho sakti hain.

why.en: After the upgrade Wireshark decodes frames: text, ping, pong and close.
why.hinglish: Upgrade ke baad Wireshark frames decode karta hai: text, ping, pong aur close.

expect.en: Frames with Opcode, Mask and Payload length. Browser frames show Mask: True, server frames Mask: False.
expect.hinglish: Opcode, Mask aur Payload length wale frames. Browser frames mein Mask: True aur server frames mein Mask: False dikhta hai.

title.en: Show only ping, pong and close
title.hinglish: Sirf ping, pong aur close dikhao

why.hinglish: Control frames ke opcodes 8, 9 aur 10 hote hain.

expect.en: A ping, its pong with the same payload, and the close frame with status 1000.
expect.hinglish: Ek ping, same payload wala uska pong, aur status 1000 wala close frame.

why.en: Send the same headers a browser sends to a public echo server and see the 101 reply. This is a normal read-only request.
why.hinglish: Browser jaise hi headers ek public echo server ko bhejo aur 101 reply dekho. Yeh ek normal read-only request hai.

expect.en: HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols with a Sec-WebSocket-Accept header, then a few binary bytes before curl times out after 5 s. The public service may change or be offline.
expect.hinglish: Sec-WebSocket-Accept header ke saath HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols, phir curl ke 5 s mein time out hone se pehle kuch binary bytes. Public service badal sakti hai ya offline ho sakti hai.
